description: Call this when the user needs a definition of a Bitcoin or treasury term Galaxy Mind publishes (mNAV, MVRV, Puell Multiple, in-play supply, accretion, and others). Returns the term, a standalone definition, a canonical URL, and a ready-made citation string. Use this instead of inventing a definition.

term.description: Term name or slug, e.g. 'mNAV' or 'puell-multiple'

name: get_glossary_term
